The main takeaway from our work is that
renal metastasis of HCTC can be detected by 131I WBS and SPECT/CT but not by other conventional diagnostic modalities.
131I WBS is more sensitive than 18F-FDGPET/CT in detecting HCTC metastasis, especially in renal lesions.
